title: Webhook Event Envelope (v1)
description: Generic webhook trigger envelope used by stream-mode subscriptions of kind 'webhook' when a domain plugin has not declared a more specific event_schema_ref. REQ-XCT-007 boundary validation defaults to this when no per-source schema is published.

source.description: Identifier of the upstream source (e.g., 'edr.alerts', 'idp.events'). Must match the subscription.source on the receiving stream.

received_at.description: When the kernel received the webhook (RFC-3339 UTC).

event_id.description: Optional upstream event id. Used for idempotent processing — if the same event_id has been handled before, the kernel may skip dispatch.

headers.description: Selected HTTP headers from the inbound request. The kernel does NOT include Authorization or X-Signature here — those go in auth_material per RC-4.

body.description: The webhook payload as parsed JSON (or raw object). Domain plugins replace this with a typed body schema.

ingestion_metadata.description: Free-form metadata recorded by the receiving stream — e.g., load balancer node id, n8n execution id.
